claims.text: Ab-initio calculations combined with machine learning can tune the magnetic behavior of non-equiatomic high-entropy alloys.
Ab-initio calculations combined with machine learning can tune the magnetocaloric behavior of non-equiatomic high-entropy alloys.
The alloy composition is the structural mediator through which the proposed method tunes behavior.
Density functional theory and machine-learning algorithms can predict the magnetic behavior of non-equiatomic high-entropy alloys.
Density functional theory and machine-learning algorithms can predict the magnetocaloric behavior of non-equiatomic high-entropy alloys.
The computational method permits screening of multiple alloy compositions.
Computational screening can identify optimal non-equiatomic high-entropy alloys.
The proposed method will produce improved magnetic behavior in non-equiatomic high-entropy alloys.
The proposed method will produce improved magnetocaloric behavior in non-equiatomic high-entropy alloys.
